text: Chilled products must be held at or below 5 C; record temperatures twice per shift.
Frozen products must be held at -18 C or colder; discard if thawed above -12 C for more than 2 hours.
Allergen labels must be checked on every delivery; any unlabelled item is quarantined until the supplier confirms.
Promotional price tags are applied Wednesday night and removed Tuesday night; mismatches are escalated to the duty manager.
Refunds for chilled goods are accepted within 24 hours with a receipt; frozen goods are not resaleable and are disposed of.
Refunds over 50 in value require duty-manager approval.
Breaks: a 30 minute unpaid break for shifts over 6 hours; a further 15 minute paid break for shifts over 9 hours.
Sickness must be reported to the store manager at least 2 hours before shift start.
Planogram resets follow the weekly reset sheet; end-caps are reset every Wednesday before opening.
Spillages are marked with a wet-floor sign immediately and cleaned within 10 minutes.
Refunds for chilled goods are accepted within 48 hours with a receipt.
